<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-component-api.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

A searchable model picker driven by the backend model menu, showing each provider's brand icon. Models whose provider is not configured are disabled rather than hidden, so the menu communicates what would be available with the right API key.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/ModelSelector.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ModelSelector } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
